info.title: Health Log API
info.description: Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Seoul). Every error response is { error: message } with an English message.

delete.summary: Delete the body record of a day

get.summary: Get the body record of a day

put.summary: Save the body record of a day

delete.summary: Delete the daily check of a day

get.summary: Get the daily check of a day with period rates

put.summary: Save the daily check of a day
Replace the name and foods of a combo

delete.summary: Remove one goal change made from a date
Delete the alcohol and tobacco record of a day

get.summary: Get the alcohol and tobacco record of a day with period totals

put.summary: Save the alcohol and tobacco record of a day

delete.summary: Remove the newest drink of a kind from a day; a count at 0 stays 0
Delete the sleep record of a day

get.summary: Get the sleep record of a day

put.summary: Save the sleep record of a day; the wake-up time must be after the bedtime

get.summary: List body records from `from` to `to` (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 366 days)
Search or list stored foods, one page at a time
List stored foods by when they were last recorded
List the goals and their changes
Judge the goals against the records of a day
Check the server and database connection
Get the water (ml) and caffeine (mg) counts and totals of a day

post.summary: Add one drink to a day: water adds 250 ml, caffeine drinks add their default mg (at most 50 per kind)

get.summary: Get the meal entries, totals, and junk-food counts of a day

post.summary: Add a meal entry from a stored food or typed in

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID per user action. A retry with the same key and request gets the first answer and adds nothing; the same key with a different request is a 409.

get.summary: List the medicines taken on a day, or every medicine split by today
List the clinic visit and medicine reminders that are due soon
Get the week or month report around a date
List clinic visits, filtered by search term or date, one page at a time

post.summary: Add a clinic visit with its procedures

get.summary: Read the day's workouts from workout-memo (read-only). The answer is { state: 'ok', workouts } or { state: 'unavailable' } when workout-memo cannot be reached

post.summary: Add every food of a combo to a meal

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID per user action. A retry with the same key and request gets the first answer and adds nothing; the same key with a different request is a 409.

post.summary: Copy one meal of another day to this day

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID per user action. A retry with the same key and request gets the first answer and adds nothing; the same key with a different request is a 409.

put.summary: Set a goal (calories, protein, sleep, sober_days, or last_meal) from a date: body { from: YYYY-MM-DD, target: whole number (last_meal: minutes from midnight, 1260 is 21:00), or null to turn the goal off }
Set or clear the time of day a meal slot was eaten
